subject: science
notes: Graphene is a sheet of carbon only one atom thick.
By weight it is many times stronger than steel, and it conducts electricity extremely well.
Graphite, the material in pencil leads, is made of countless graphene layers stacked on top of one another.
In 2004 Andre Geim and Konstantin Novoselov at the University of Manchester isolated graphene by repeatedly peeling layers off a flake of graphite with ordinary adhesive tape.
Geim and Novoselov were awarded the 2010 Nobel Prize in Physics for their work on graphene.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the contrast between the simplicity of the method and the importance of the result. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: In 2004 Andre Geim and Konstantin Novoselov at the University of Manchester isolated graphene by peeling layers off a flake of graphite with adhesive tape.
choices.B: Although Geim and Novoselov first isolated graphene with nothing more than ordinary adhesive tape, the achievement earned them the 2010 Nobel Prize in Physics.
choices.C: Graphene, a sheet of carbon only one atom thick, is many times stronger than steel by weight and conducts electricity extremely well.
choices.D: Geim and Novoselov received the 2010 Nobel Prize in Physics for their work on graphene, a sheet of carbon only one atom thick.

explanation.why: The goal names a contrast with two sides: a simple method and an important result. The method is peeling graphite with ordinary adhesive tape; the importance is shown by the Nobel Prize. Only one choice places the two side by side, and its "Although" makes the contrast explicit.
explanation.A: Incorrect. It gives the simple method but nothing about the importance of the result, so there is no contrast.
explanation.B: Correct. "Nothing more than ordinary adhesive tape" stresses the simplicity, and the Nobel Prize shows the importance.
explanation.C: Incorrect. It describes graphene's properties and says nothing about how it was isolated or how the work was recognized.
explanation.D: Incorrect. It gives the importance (the Nobel Prize) but leaves out the tape method, so the simplicity side of the contrast is missing.
